Please, check out their channels and show them some love!

2D underwater physics-based action co-op for up to 4 players. Crew a submarine, harpoon loot and drag it back before oxygen runs out. Deeper the dive---higher the stakes and darker the horrors. All wrapped in an absurdly cute deep-sea exploration vibe with unforgettable chaotic dogs and crazy fish.
